points.title: Overlapping Tier-1 and Tier-2 transfer reason codes

gold.output: Transfer successful (reason: customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal). A human agent will assist you shortly.

doc_faithful.output: Transfer successful (reason: unconfirmed_external_communication). A human agent will assist you shortly.
doc_faithful.note: Plausible misreading: flyer-matching Tier-2 choice; the highest-tier rule still favours gold. 3 of 4 earlier Opus trials picked this code.

refs.quote: Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

| customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal | Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human |
| unconfirmed_external_communication | Customer claims a specific promotion/program/offer exists (they have a letter, email, or flyer) but you cannot verify or find it in the KB after searching |

points.conflict: Both rows describe a flyer offer absent from the KB; gold step 0 requires the Tier-1 code (compare_args=["reason"]), Tier-2 also fits literally.
